tv_trade_league_create_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_founder
	if = {
		limit = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = TV_HAS_VARIABLE_NOT_SET_TT
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_league_member }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_member value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_founder
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_league_self_establishing value = 1 }
			create_international_organization = {
				type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				hidden_effect = {
					add_country_to_international_organization = prev
					set_leader_country = prev
				}
			}
			every_international_organizations_member_of = {
				limit = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_founder
				}
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
				leader_country ?= {
					save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
					tv_trade_league_ensure_trade_chain_capital_effect = yes
					tv_trade_league_refresh_monopoly_markets_if_needed_effect = yes
				}
				tv_trade_league_update_all_monopolies_if_new_global_markets_effect = yes
				leader_country ?= {
					tv_trade_league_refresh_monopoly_members_display_effect = yes
				}
			}
			remove_variable = tv_trade_league_self_establishing
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_horses_effect = {
	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_horses ?= {
		market = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses } }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses scale = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses } months = -1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_horses_effect = {
	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_horses ?= {
		market = {

				limit = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses }
				remove_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_horses
			}
		}
	}
}

	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_steel ?= {
		market = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_steel } }
				add_temporary_demand = { type = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_steel scale = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_steel } months = -1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_steel_effect = {
	var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_steel ?= {
		market = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_steel }
				remove_temporary_demand = demand:tv_trade_virtual_demand_steel
			}
		}
	}
}

	save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
	var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_steel ?= {

			add_goods_supply = { goods = goods:steel amount = { value = scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_steel } }
		}
		scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader = {
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_applied_steel value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		}

tv_trade_league_recalculate_action_accounting_horses_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_horses } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_horses value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_horses } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_horses value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_embargo_active_horses } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_horses value = 0 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_horses value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses divide = 5 } }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_horses value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses divide = 5 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_horses value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_horses >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_horses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_horses >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_horses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_horses >= 1 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_horses value = 30 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses add = 30 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	change_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses subtract = var:tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_horses }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses value = 0 }
	}

	}
}

		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_beeswax } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_beeswax value = { value = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_beeswax divide = 5 } }

	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_beeswax value = 0 }

		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_beeswax >= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_trade_used_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_beeswax }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beeswax >= 1 }

tv_trade_league_clear_trade_chain_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		tv_trade_league_clear_trade_chain_demands_effect = yes
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_count
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_length
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_flow
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_flow_denominator
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_flow_zero
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_strength
		remove_variable = tv_trade_chain_strength_display
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot
		clear_variable_list = tv_trade_chain_markets
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_1
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_2
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_3
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_4
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_5
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_6
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_7
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_8
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_9
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_10
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_11
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_12
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_13
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_14
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_15
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_16
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_17
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_18
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_19
		clear_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_demand_slot_20
		remove_country_modifier = tv_trade_chain_medium_modifier
		remove_country_modifier = tv_trade_chain_strong_modifier
	}
}

tv_trade_league_reset_trade_chain_to_capital_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		tv_trade_league_clear_trade_chain_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital.market }
			capital.market = {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_chain_capital_market
			}
			add_to_variable_map = { name = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot key = 1 value = scope:tv_trade_chain_capital_market }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = tv_trade_chain_markets target = scope:tv_trade_chain_capital_market }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_count value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_length value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_strength value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_strength_display value = 0 }
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_ensure_trade_chain_capital_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = capital.market }
			capital.market = {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_chain_current_capital_market
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_chain_count }
						NOT = { has_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot }
						NOT = { is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot target = 1 } }
						NOT = { "variable_map(tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot|1)" ?= { this = scope:tv_trade_chain_current_capital_market } }
					}
				}
				tv_trade_league_reset_trade_chain_to_capital_effect = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			tv_trade_league_clear_trade_chain_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_on_capital_moved_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_international_organizations_member_of = {
					international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
					leader_country ?= root
				}
				exists = scope:old_capital.market
				exists = scope:new_capital.market
				scope:old_capital.market = {
					NOT = { this = scope:new_capital.market }
				}
			}
			tv_trade_league_reset_trade_chain_to_capital_effect = yes
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_trade_league_chain.1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_refresh_trade_chain_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = tv_trade_chain_leader
		tv_trade_league_ensure_trade_chain_capital_effect = yes
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_length_calc value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow_calc value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow_denominator_calc value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow_zero_calc value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_strength_calc value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_strength_display_calc value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_length value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow_denominator value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow_zero value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_strength value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_strength_display value = 0 }
		remove_country_modifier = tv_trade_chain_medium_modifier
		remove_country_modifier = tv_trade_chain_strong_modifier
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_chain_count ?= { this > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_chain_count ?= { this >= 1 }
				has_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot target = 1 }
			}
			"variable_map(tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot|1)" = {
				set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_slot_capacity value = { value = "merchant_capacity(scope:tv_trade_chain_leader)" } }
				scope:tv_trade_chain_leader = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:tv_trade_chain_slot_capacity <= 0 }
						set_local_variable = { name = tv_trade_chain_flow_zero_calc value = 1 }
					}
					else = {
						change_local_variable = {
							name = tv_trade_chain_flow_denominator_calc
							add = {
								value = 1
								divide = local_var:tv_trade_chain_slot_capacity
							}
						}
					}
				}
				remove_local_variable = tv_trade_chain_slot_capacity
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:tv_trade_chain_count ?= { this >= 2 }
				has_variable_map = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot
				is_key_in_variable_map = { name = tv_trade_chain_market_by_slot target = 2 }

					scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source = { has_variable = tv_trade_intelligence_io_power_300 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_intelligence_row_10_io_power value = scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source.var:tv_trade_intelligence_io_power_300 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_intelligence_row_10_strength_pct value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source
					scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source = { has_variable = tv_trade_intelligence_strength_pct_300 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_intelligence_row_10_strength_pct value = scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source.var:tv_trade_intelligence_strength_pct_300 }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_intelligence_row_10_active value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source
					scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source = { has_variable = tv_trade_intelligence_active_300 }
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_intelligence_row_10_active value = scope:tv_trade_intelligence_display_source.var:tv_trade_intelligence_active_300 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_selected_intelligence_slot } }
			tv_trade_league_select_first_displayed_intelligence_market_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			tv_trade_league_refresh_selected_intelligence_projection_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_update_all_monopolies_if_new_global_markets_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
		leader_country ?= {
			save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
			set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_markets_global_version_cache value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = tv_trade_monopoly_markets_refresh_version }
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_markets_global_version_cache value = global_var:tv_trade_monopoly_markets_refresh_version }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_monopoly_markets_seen_version }
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_markets_seen_version < var:tv_trade_monopoly_markets_global_version_cache
					}
				}
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_io = {
					tv_trade_league_update_all_monopolies_effect = yes
				}
				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_monopoly_markets_seen_version value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_markets_global_version_cache }
			}
			remove_variable = tv_trade_monopoly_markets_global_version_cache
		}
	}
}

tv_trade_league_country_monthly_pulse_effect = {
	hidden_effect = {
		save_scope_as = tv_trade_league_pulse_country
		every_international_organizations_member_of = {
			limit = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:tv_trade_league_pulse_country
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					international_organization_has_leader = yes
					leader_country ?= { exists = capital.market }
				}
				leader_country ?= {
					save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
					tv_trade_league_refresh_trade_chain_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				leader_country ?= {
					tv_trade_league_clear_trade_chain_effect = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					international_organization_has_leader = yes
					leader_country ?= {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_GRAND_MERCHANT_CHAR_TT
							has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
						}
						var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
					}
				}
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_io
				leader_country ?= {
					save_scope_as = tv_trade_monopoly_leader
					tv_trade_league_update_intelligence_effect = yes
					tv_trade_league_refresh_intelligence_members_display_effect = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				leader_country ?= {
					tv_trade_league_clear_intelligence_merchant_power_effect = yes
					remove_variable = tv_trade_intelligence_active_market
					remove_variable = tv_trade_commercial_intelligence_active
					remove_variable = tv_trade_intelligence_active_slot
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					international_organization_has_leader = yes
					leader_country ?= {
						custom_tooltip = {
							text = TV_HAS_GRAND_MERCHANT_CHAR_TT
							has_variable = tv_grand_merchant_char
						}
						var:tv_grand_merchant_char ?= { is_alive = yes }
						tv_grand_merchant_available_for_monopoly_trigger = yes
					}
				}
				tv_trade_league_update_monopolies_effect = yes
			}
			else = {
				leader_country ?= {
					tv_trade_league_suspend_virtual_demands_effect = yes
					tv_trade_league_suspend_virtual_supplies_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_beeswax < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_beeswax < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_beeswax_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_beeswax >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beeswax >= 1
			NOT = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_applied_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 } }

		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_beeswax_effect = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_beeswax < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beeswax < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_beeswax_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_beeswax >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_beeswax >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_beeswax ?= {
				save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_target
				scope:tv_trade_monopoly_leader.var:tv_trade_embargo_location_beeswax ?= {

							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}


	# Monopoly action upkeep for slaves_goods
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	}
	if = {

	}
	set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = var:tv_trade_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods }

		set_variable = { name = tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
	}

	if = {
		limit = {
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_slaves_goods >= 1
		}
		tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_slaves_goods_effect = yes
	}
	if = {

	if = {

			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1

		}

	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods < 1
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods < 1
			}
		}
		tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
	}

	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods >= 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_trade_embargo_active_slaves_goods >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_embargo_country_slaves_goods ?= {

							months = 2
							power = merchant_power_severe_penalty
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

		}
	}

	}
}
